title: aidd list --json
description: What `aidd list --json` prints: `{schema_version, steps}` for one repository, or, given several repositories, `{schema_version, repos}` with the steps by path. `aidd gate --paths --json` uses the same steps (forecast.schema.json). A new optional key may be added in a minor release without a version bump, and a consumer ignores keys it does not know; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

steps.description: One repository's open work, most urgent first.

scope.description: all: every Spec approval and Merge approval; all-but-major: all but major and emergency changes.

until.description: The last day it holds, when the person named one.

standing.description: The person's standing approval in force (`approve all`): the agent records each approval it covers, until they stop it. Absent when none is.

explore_branch.description: The explore branch this worktree is on: free edits, with no Spec or scope check, and nothing merges from it as it is. Absent on any other branch.

age_days.description: Days since its oldest commit the default branch lacks; 0 while it has none.

behind.description: Commits of the default branch it does not hold yet: `aidd sync` on it merges them in.

specs.description: The Specs that ship into it (their `base`), and the ones it holds.

integrated.description: The Specs `aidd integrate` landed in it, read from the `Aidd-Integrate` trailers of its merge commits.

release_ready.description: At least one Spec is integrated, every other Spec that ships into it is finished, and it holds every commit of the default branch: the person's Merge approval releases it.

warnings.description: Past gates.max_goal_days, or behind the default branch: what to do about each.

goals.description: Each local goal branch (`goal/<name>`), the team's integration branch: what ships into it, what it holds, and whether it is ready to release. Absent with --branch, or when there is none.

branch.description: A local branch with work the default branch does not hold yet.

age_days.description: Days since its oldest own commit.

behind.description: Commits of the default branch it does not hold yet: `aidd sync` merges them in.

branches.description: The branches with unmerged work, goal branches aside, oldest first.

warnings.description: Past gates.max_open_branches or gates.max_branch_days: what to do about each.

flow.description: Trunk-based flow (DORA: three or fewer active branches, each merged at least daily): the branches with unmerged work and the warnings their count and age give. Absent with --branch, or when no branch holds unmerged work.

repos.description: Given several repositories: each one's steps, by the path given.

step.description: One step. Further keys (such as a Spec's `tasks`) may be added in a minor release; a consumer ignores keys it does not know.

code.description: The kind of step, stable across wording changes, such as `spec.in_review`.

where.description: The file or place the step is about, such as a Spec's path; empty when none.

unready.description: A committed draft Spec that is not finished: the first reason (placeholders in what the gate runs, or a schema error). It goes back to Specify, never to Spec approval or Implement.

what.description: What is open, in a sentence.

who.description: Who acts next, as a role noun: agent (or agent (ROLE), when a handoff note names the role), author, Approver, triager, or decision maker; in the list, a named owner, or the owner's agent, for work someone else drives.

how.description: How to do it: the command or action.

id.description: The Spec's, Epic's, Initiative's, or proposal's id, when the step is about one.

status.description: The item's derived status (a Spec's, a container's, or a proposal's), never the stored cache.

blocked.description: Whether the item is blocked: a flag, not a status (blocked_on, unfinished blocked_by work, or a Task out of retries).

priority.description: Its priority, its own or inherited from its Epic or Initiative; urgent for an emergency.

owner.description: The person who owns the item, when it names one. `aidd list` also puts them in `who`.

files.description: What the work item's folder (`specs/<ID>/`, beside its file) holds, when it has one: each linked document by its kind, the `design` folder, each `exploration` with its question and status, and any other `folder`; at most 20, then one `more` entry with the count.

path.description: The file or folder, from the repository root.

kind.description: A linked document's kind (such as `tech-spec`, or `doc`), `design`, `exploration`, `folder`, or `more`.

owner.description: The role that owns an exploration.

count.description: For `more`: how many entries are not listed.

age_days.description: Work item age, on each step of a Spec in progress: whole days since it entered in progress. On a branch, that is the earliest author date of the commits since the fork that changed a Task's scope. Where the stored status answered, it is the committer date of the commit that set it, as `aidd log` reads it. Absent when neither says, and in a shallow clone.

aged.description: Whether `age_days` is past `gates.max_in_progress_days` (10 while unset): true past it, and present as false within it. Absent when that limit is 0 (off), or with no `age_days`.

waiting_minutes.description: On an Approver's wait while `gates.escalate_after_minutes` is set: the minutes since the wait began. For Merge approval, that is the head commit the evidence is green on; for Spec approval, the last commit that touched the Spec. Absent when the wait has no commit yet.

escalated.description: True once `waiting_minutes` is past `gates.escalate_after_minutes`; absent otherwise. It changes what the list says, never who may approve.

backup_approvers.description: With `escalated` (past `gates.escalate_after_minutes`): the humans in `owners.backup_approvers` to ask instead; empty when none are named.

branch.description: In the backlog, the branch the item was read from (the base branch, or the open branch whose copy won).

goal.description: The goal branch the Spec ships into (its `base`, such as goal/booking), so a goal's Specs can be read together.

id.description: The Task's id, or null when it has none.

status.description: Derived: todo (an agent may start it), in_progress (commits change its scope), done (its scope changed and the evidence is green on head, the Spec is past implementation, or a person recorded done), blocked (the Spec is not approved or is blocked, or a Task in waiting_on is not done), or stopped (out of retries, or the handoff note stopped while it was in progress).

tasks.description: A Spec's Tasks with their state, for a coordinator that starts one agent per todo Task.
